title: Wheat for the Town
description: Irienne will teach you to make a Farming workplace. Townsfolk plant and tend their own wheat to support more residents. This workplace produces food supply, not items to collect.

objectives.text: Unlock Farming workplaces through Irienne's building and workplace upgrades.
Mark bare ground with the Building Staff, choose Farming and save. Include at least four clear dirt, grass or tilled-soil spaces.
Place a Farmer's Workbench inside the marked area, at the same floor as the growing spaces.
Employ a resident, enable Farming in work priorities, and let them plant wheat and finish tending. No seeds are needed. This adds 10 food points for 5 residents, not inventory items.
Return to Irienne to discuss your town's food supply.
